title: Coral and the Ember
author: Casper Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Eriksen, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
